lines.plainText: But thou prefer'st thy life before thine honour

lines.text: And seeing thou dost, I here divorce myself
lines.plainText: And seeing thou dost I here divorce myself

lines.text: Both from thy table, Henry, and thy bed,
lines.plainText: Both from thy table Henry and thy bed

lines.text: Until that act of parliament be repealed
lines.plainText: Until that act of parliament be repealed

lines.text: Whereby my son is disinherited.
lines.plainText: Whereby my son is disinherited

lines.text: The northern lords that have forsworn thy colours
lines.plainText: The northern lords that have forsworn thy colours

lines.text: Will follow mine if once they see them spread;
lines.plainText: Will follow mine if once they see them spread

lines.text: And spread they shall be, to thy foul disgrace
lines.plainText: And spread they shall be to thy foul disgrace

lines.text: And utter ruin of the house of York.
lines.plainText: And utter ruin of the house of York

lines.text: Thus do I leave thee. Come, son, let's away:
lines.plainText: Thus do I leave thee Come son let's away

lines.text: Our army is ready; come, we'll after them.
lines.plainText: Our army is ready come we'll after them

lines.text: Stay, gentle Margaret, and hear me speak.
lines.plainText: Stay gentle Margaret and hear me speak

lines.text: Thou hast spoke too much already. Get thee gone.
lines.plainText: Thou hast spoke too much already Get thee gone

lines.text: Gentle son Edward, thou wilt stay with me?
lines.plainText: Gentle son Edward thou wilt stay with me

lines.text: Ay, to be murdered by his enemies.
lines.plainText: Ay to be murdered by his enemies

lines.text: When I return with victory from the field
lines.plainText: When I return with victory from the field

lines.text: I'll see your Grace. Till then I'll follow her.
lines.plainText: I'll see your Grace Till then I'll follow her

lines.text: Come, son, away; we may not linger thus.
lines.plainText: Come son away we may not linger thus

lines.text: Poor queen! How love to me and to her son
lines.plainText: Poor queen How love to me and to her son

lines.text: Hath made her break out into terms of rage!
lines.plainText: Hath made her break out into terms of rage

lines.text: Revenged may she be on that hateful Duke,
lines.plainText: Revenged may she be on that hateful Duke

lines.text: Whose haughty spirit, winged with desire,
lines.plainText: Whose haughty spirit winged with desire

lines.text: Will cost my crown, and like an empty eagle
lines.plainText: Will cost my crown and like an empty eagle

lines.text: Tire on the flesh of me and of my son.
lines.plainText: Tire on the flesh of me and of my son

lines.text: The loss of those three lords torments my heart.
lines.plainText: The loss of those three lords torments my heart

lines.text: I'll write unto them and entreat them fair.
lines.plainText: I'll write unto them and entreat them fair

lines.text: Come, cousin, you shall be the messenger.
lines.plainText: Come cousin you shall be the messenger

lines.text: And I, I hope, shall reconcile them all.
